title: Female borrowers who describe themselves as 'hardworking' may fund faster.
Female borrowers who describe themselves as 'dedicated smallholder farmers' may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention being a widow may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention being married may fund faster.
Pitches from women that explicitly reference a successful history of repaying previous loans are associated with increased funding speed.
Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to lenders or partners may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who provide exact quantities for business inputs may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention their age and marital status may fund faster.
Female borrowers who list specific inventory items like canned goods may fund faster.
Female borrowers who list specific agricultural inputs like seeds or fertilizers may fund more slowly.
Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention sustaining business through past NWTF loans fund faster.
Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Mentioning family obligations or the number of dependents predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
